title: Sync engine
summary: The tool and skill that install this setup, bring in updates one by one and roll back. Say "sync my setup" to use it.
details: Say sync my setup and Claude drives the command line tool that installed this setup: it shows a menu of parts on first run, brings in updates one by one, can roll back to a version, and re-adds parts later. Use it after following START.md to keep the setup current or to undo a change. It installs a node tool at tools/claude-manners/sync plus a skill; it runs git and node when you ask, writes only the files and settings it lists, and keeps backups.
trigger: Say "sync my setup", "roll back my setup" or "go back to version X".
risk: Runs git and node when you ask to sync. Writes only files and settings it lists, with backups.
